t: Forge Steel adjustable basin wrench is a durable plumbing tool engineered for the efficient tightening and loosening of challenging tap fittings. Ideal wrench for professional plumbers and installers working on pillar and bath taps in confined spaces. Features a pivoting head which provides adjustable access to 15mm and 22mm back and union nuts, significantly simplifying tap installation and removal. Constructed with a forged steel jaw and a robust iron rod handle, the basin wrench offers exceptional durability and reliability for demanding plumbing tasks.
